propositions: Endpoint fuse must open after three consecutive eligible exhausted logical outcomes across at least two distinct tickets
Provider fuse additionally requires failing outcomes to span two or more distinct endpoints of the same provider
Matching success outcomes must reset consecutive state for that scope independent of other scopes

Fuse eligibility is determined by budget-exhaustion provenance (RetryBudget.plan_next_retry action=exhausted or action=defer at cap) not disposition value, excluding physical attempts, recovered warnings, permanent failures, ticket-local 404s, and opaque commit_unknown
Open fuse must return explicit scope, reason, and retry_not_before metadata without executing remaining plans
Per-pass in-memory per-scope counters are zeroed each reconcile_once pass with independent scope state management
